# Named identities, asserted byte for byte.
#
# The browser and server are replaced by the hooks
# in scripthooks.go, compiled in under the nlmscripttest tag. A private HOME
# keeps the identities this file writes out of the other script tests.

env HOME=$HOME/identity-ux

# A fresh installation has no identities and says so instead of printing an
# empty table.
exec ./nlm_test auth list
stdout '\Ano identities stored; run ''nlm auth login'' to create one\n\z'

# Logging in under a name stores that name, and says which one, so a second
# account is visibly separate from the first.
env NLM_TEST_BROWSER_AUTH=ok
exec ./nlm_test auth login --as work --authuser 3
stderr '\Anlm: authenticating via browser \(profile nlm, account 3\)\.\.\.\nnlm: credentials written to identity work\n\z'

# A second identity inherits nothing from the first: --as personal is a login
# for personal's account, not a re-login for work's.
exec ./nlm_test auth login --as personal
stderr '\Anlm: authenticating via browser \(profile nlm\)\.\.\.\nnlm: credentials written to identity personal\n\z'

# The first identity stored on a fresh machine became current; a later one
# does not steal the selection.
exec ./nlm_test auth list
stdout 'work +nlm +3 +current'
stdout 'personal +nlm +- *'

# Naming an identity that does not exist is a usage error, and names the ones
# that do rather than leaving the user guessing.
! exec ./nlm_test --identity nope auth list
stderr 'unknown identity "nope"; stored identities: personal, work'

exec ./nlm_test auth use personal
stderr '\Anlm: current identity is now personal\n\z'

# Removing the current identity moves the selection rather than leaving the
# removed session in place.
exec ./nlm_test auth remove personal
stderr '\Anlm: removed identity personal\nnlm: current identity is now work\n\z'

# Deleting the final identity must not recreate an empty default identity.
exec ./nlm_test auth remove work
exec ./nlm_test auth list
stdout '\Ano identities stored; run ''nlm auth login'' to create one\n\z'
! exists $HOME/.nlm/env
! exists $HOME/.nlm/current
